surface: Complete against the published `lucide-react@1.45.0` runtime surface: every canonical icon and alias, the `icons` namespace, `Icon`, `createLucideIcon`, `LucideProvider`, `useLucideContext`, `DynamicIcon`, `iconNames`, `dynamicIconImports`, and per-icon subpath imports.
divergences: Icon refs are normal Octane `ref` props rather than React `forwardRef` components.
Event callbacks receive native DOM events rather than React synthetic events.
ssr: Supported and tested: icons and provider defaults render through `octane/server`, and client hydration adopts the server-rendered SVG element.
notes: Generated wrappers consume official framework-neutral @lucide/icons@1.45.0 data and its public build export. The Octane bridge supports icon data, nested nodes, custom view boxes, and non-scaling strokes without copying new React implementation.
Generation checks pin the React export, alias, and dynamic-name surfaces and reject stale generated files.

Two shared runtime differential scenarios plus complete canonical SVG comparisons, direct public type probes, hydration, native refs/events and dynamic-import lifecycle tests cover the current dependency. The historical upstream runtime suite remains unvendored and unadapted one-for-one.
Every pinned upstream test artifact and public entry-point family is dispositioned in UPSTREAM.md.

Release identities are recorded in audit/release-compatibility.json. Historical ISC source attribution remains recorded-unverified; the current dependency update does not claim full upstream-suite parity.
